content.value: A double acting cylinder is used to perform pressing operation. Cylinder has to move forward when PB1 button is pressed and return for set time of 20 seconds before it automatically returns to initial position. Limit switch S2 is used for end sensing of the forward motion of the cylinder. Draw the pneumatic circuit, PLC wiring diagram, and ladder diagram to implement this task.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
